subject.title: Uncaught exception in resolveMemoryReadFailureResult when supplement lookup throws

question: Which open closing PR should be treated as the canonical fix for this memory_get supplement-fallback bug?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but two contributor PRs target the same path and one is draft while the other is current-base; choosing which candidate to land or supersede is maintainer review work, not an issue auto-close.

options.title: Review the current-base candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101902 as the likely canonical fix because it targets current main and is not draft, then close or supersede the duplicate after the fix path is chosen.

options.title: Adopt the draft candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101827 if maintainers prefer that branch, but it needs draft/proof follow-up before landing.

options.title: Replace both candidates
options.body: Close both contributor PRs only after opening or landing a narrower maintainer replacement that preserves the same regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Review the current-base candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101902 as the likely canonical fix because it targets current main and is not draft, then close or supersede the duplicate after the fix path is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the issue and introduced the wiki corpus supplement bridge that owns the affected behavior.
